newsitem.title: USA: Enron, Portland Genl merger to close July 1.
newsitem.headline: Enron, Portland Genl merger to close July 1.

text.p: Enron Corp and Portland General Corp will close their merger on July 1, subject to confirmation of certain agreement conditions, the companies said Thursday.

Enron said it will issue 50.5 million new and common shares to Portland General shareholders, consolidate Portland General's debt of $1.1 billion and account for the transaction on a purchase accounting basis.
The $3 billion merger will result in a firm with a market value of around $12 billion, the companies said.

"With states around the country opening up to retail competition as early as January 1, 1998, we look forward to utilizing the capabilities of our combined entity in the $200 billion retail electricity marketplace," said Kenneth Lay, Enron chief executive officer.
The merger links Enron, the largest wholesale marketer of natural gas and electricity in North America, with Portland General, a low-cost electric utility based in Oregon.
